description: Bulk clone one or more test cases into a target project and optional folder. Each clone gets a fresh key; original test cases keep their existing folder memberships and linkages. Returns a background task with taskId and progressUrl — poll the progressUrl until status is 'Completed' (Title case, not COMPLETED).

folderId.description: Target folder ID. Use -1 for root.

testCaseIds.description: Test case UIDs (strings, from search_test_cases — e.g. '4qpaflGmcp4gNM')

name: qtm4j_clone_test_cases
title: Clone Test Cases
